host.description: IP address the server binds to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only).

root.description: Document root directory (files served from this path).

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Set to 'stderr' to log to standard error.

mime_file.description: Path to the MIME types definition file.

index_files.description: List of filenames to serve when a directory is requested.

user.description: User to drop privileges to after binding to port.

group.description: Group to drop privileges to after binding to port.

allow_symlink.description: Whether to follow symbolic links outside the document root.

allow_dir_listing.description: Whether to show directory listings when no index file exists.

threads.description: Number of worker threads (0 for single-threaded).

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL/TLS certificate file (only used if SSL is enabled).

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL/TLS private key file (only used if SSL is enabled).

server_headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to add to every response.

allowed_ips.description: List of allowed client IP addresses (if empty, all IPs are allowed).

error_404.description: Path (relative to root) or absolute path to custom 404 error page.

error_50x.description: Path (relative to root) or absolute path to custom 5xx error page (optional).

read_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for an incoming request before closing the connection.

write_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a response write before closing the connection.
